meta.title: Two bids: award all 10 units to Vendor A (not the lowest); approver approves without a remark
gaps: The prepared state contains only one vendor and one bid, so the case's two bids from Vendor A and Vendor B and the choice of Vendor A as not the lowest cannot be tested.

Allocating exactly 10 units and verifying Vendor A's 10 × 100 = 1,000 result cannot be tested because the prepared state has only one line and its available quantity and vendor prices are not the requested two-bid data.
The expected Awarded Vendors value of 1/2 cannot be tested because the prepared state has only one vendor.
Filling and submitting the required proposal fields with the requested allocation cannot be verified for the missing two-vendor scenario.

Signing in as a separate approver and approving with an empty remark, including the refusal message "Remark is necessary for approval", cannot be tested because the catalog has no separate approver session or empty-remark approval action.

steps.note: Open Master QCS for the prepared closed RFQ with its available bid.
Assert the prepared Master QCS has one real vendor column; this exposes the missing second bid/vendor.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate the available line to the only vendor in the prepared state.
Assert the available single-line allocation counters moved successfully.
